name: MISP (local instance)
desc: Open-source threat sharing platform. Runs locally, consumes public OSINT feeds, and feeds OpenCTI through the official MISP connector.

name: CIRCL OSINT Feed
desc: The Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg's public MISP feed: a broad, well-curated stream of OSINT events and attributes.

name: abuse.ch Feodo Tracker
desc: Botnet command-and-control IP blocklist covering Emotet, Dridex, QakBot and related families.

name: Botvrij.eu
desc: Dutch-curated OSINT MISP feed of indicators and hunting leads.

name: OpenPhish
desc: Community phishing URL feed. Complements Phishunt for credential-harvesting pages.

name: Phishunt
desc: Active phishing URLs from a keyless public feed. The closest match to the credential-harvesting lures that dominate local inboxes.

name: RansomLook
desc: Ransomware leak-site claims with victim and group context. Free substitute for the paid Ransomware.live API.

name: MITRE ATT&CK
desc: Enterprise, Mobile and ICS tactics, techniques and procedures, mapped into OpenCTI's knowledge graph.

name: MITRE ATLAS
desc: Adversarial tactics and techniques against AI systems — increasingly relevant as local organisations adopt AI tooling.

name: CISA KEV
desc: The US catalogue of vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild. Used as a prioritisation signal, not as an Aruba-specific feed.

name: OpenCTI Datasets
desc: Reference identities, countries and sectors so reports can be linked to Aruba, Curaçao, Bonaire and local sectors consistently.

name: AlienVault OTX
desc: Community pulses with indicators. Optional: enabled by setting ALIENVAULT_API_KEY and starting the otx profile.

name: abuse.ch ThreatFox
desc: IOC sharing platform for malware C2 and payloads. Optional: requires an abuse.ch Auth-Key.

name: Ransomware.live
desc: Ransomware leak-site tracking. Optional: requires a ransomware.live API key.
